_regression.source: real map: Sawada (scripted hamlet) as its fabric stood before the paddy size floor, captured 2026-08-17 by running the gen with this change's three placer guards patched off (_TOE_MIN_AREA, _WELD_MIN_SOLIDITY, _TINT_MIN_SOLIDITY). The GM read these off a hamlet render as 'a few very small triangles ... basically a rendering artifact': boundary offcuts of the plot lattice, 240-370 sq ft against a 1,488 sq ft design cell, each walled with its own full perimeter of aze. They are neither needles nor thin, so paddy_plots_are_workable_basins and _TOE_MIN_THICKNESS both pass them - only a size floor can see them. The fix drops them in the toe pass and absorbs them in close_seams, which is this module's standing answer for an awkward scrap: taken into the basin beside it rather than walled off on its own.
